lady.oewn-10008828-n.label: positive

family.axis: polite respect → praise of fine manners

lady.oewn-10008828-n.tone: The plainest word for a woman of grace and good manners, and warmer than *gentlewoman*.

maam.oewn-10008828-n.label: positive

family.axis: polite respect → praise of fine manners

maam.oewn-10008828-n.tone: A shortened *madam*: the same respect for a refined woman, said more softly and briefly.

madam.oewn-10008828-n.label: positive

family.axis: polite respect → praise of fine manners

madam.oewn-10008828-n.tone: Formal and respectful, it names a refined woman while keeping more distance than *lady*.

dame.oewn-10008828-n.label: positive

family.axis: polite respect → praise of fine manners

dame.oewn-10008828-n.tone: Stately and formal, it gives a refined woman more weight and dignity than *lady* does.

gentlewoman.oewn-10008828-n.label: positive

family.axis: polite respect → praise of fine manners

gentlewoman.oewn-10008828-n.tone: It spells out the gentle manners that *lady* only suggests, in a more formal voice.

scheme.oewn-05913942-n.label: neutral

family.axis: one set move in a game → a line of action a person or group takes on

scheme.oewn-05913942-n.tone: Stresses size and order: a plan with many worked-out parts, more elaborate than a plain *plan*.

play.oewn-00558625-n.label: neutral

family.axis: one set move in a game → a line of action a person or group takes on

play.oewn-00558625-n.tone: A plan set in advance that a sports team runs during a game, far narrower than a *scheme*.

system.oewn-05911466-n.label: neutral

family.axis: one set move in a game → a line of action a person or group takes on

system.oewn-05911466-n.tone: Puts the weight on method: the steps or process you follow to reach a goal.

policy.oewn-05910115-n.label: neutral

family.axis: one set move in a game → a line of action a person or group takes on

policy.oewn-05910115-n.tone: A plan a person or group has chosen and taken on as their own; the stress is on that choice.
